svg.title: Scale dot products before softmax
svg.desc: For independent unit-variance query and key components, the dot product variance is d_k. Dividing by sqrt(d_k) restores unit variance and prevents softmax saturation.

g.text: Dividing by √dₖ keeps score variance near one and avoids saturated softmax.
For dₖ = 64: raw-score standard deviation is 8.
